offering_description.value: Promotes and produces live music concerts and festivals, operates venues, and sells tickets through its ticketing platform. It also sells sponsorships and advertising to brands. Customers are fans, artists, venues and corporate sponsors.

primary_products.value: concert and festival tickets; ticketing software; sponsorship packages; venue food, beverage and merchandise

primary_services.value: concert promotion and production; ticketing services; venue operation and management; artist management; sponsorship and advertising sales

customer_segment.value: B2C: concert and festival attendees buying tickets and venue concessions; B2B: artists, event organizers, venue owners using ticketing, and corporate sponsors and advertisers

end_markets.value: live music; entertainment; sports and theater ticketing; advertising and sponsorship

revenue_model.value: service fees: concert promotion revenue from ticket sales, venue rentals and artist show costs; transaction or usage fees: ticketing service fees per ticket sold; other: sponsorship and advertising fees from brands; product sales: food, beverage and merchandise at venues and festivals
revenue_model.category: service fees; transaction or usage fees; other; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: books artists, promotes and produces shows, sold to fans; asset operator: owns and operates amphitheaters, clubs and theaters hosting events; software / platform: ticketing marketplace serving venues and promoters, selling to fans
value_chain_position.category: service provider; asset operator; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific and other markets in dozens of countries

specialization.value: related lines: concerts, ticketing, and sponsorship and advertising, all around live events

distribution_channels.value: online: ticketing websites and mobile apps selling tickets to fans; own locations: owned and operated amphitheaters, theaters and clubs; direct sales: sponsorship sales teams and ticketing sales to venues

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: antitrust scrutiny by DOJ and FTC, consumer ticketing and fee rules, venue safety and liquor licensing
